decay.law: wanted decays on a schedule (per-level data rates; faster outside the region; cleared early by answering the finding or completing #275 restitution); morale NEVER decays on a timer — only deeds move it
decay.theOneError: confusing the two decays — the law forgets on a schedule; the soul does not

flow: seen — witness set computed at the deed (#93/#145 presence, the victim always, bystanders); aftermath-arrival is a weaker class (deed known, doer described)
reported — the witness carries word to a law seat; reports take time and can fail to arrive (outrun, persuaded per #244, intimidated per #269's -3 deed — which may itself be witnessed)
wanted — a landed report sets the regional wanted level from the gravest reported deed + reported history; the law reads only the witnessed subset of the ledger, ever
note: The split is the research-backed rule (RESEARCH-SOURCES.md): RDR2's mask blocks recognition, not conscience — morale = conscience (every deed, seen or unseen), wanted = evidence (witnessed, reported fact only).

response.aboveLicence: at pursued+: NPC Rangers (#93/#145) actively seek the wanted Ranger (recovery demand #273 / initiated duel #210); at hunted: patrol encounters (world data); at most-wanted: bounty-class hunters — and the underworld reads being hunted as a credential (#270 swapped valence)
response.licence: landed reports ground #230 findings — warning -> supervised -> suspension; punishment never touches the Mochi (#230's law, inherited)

victimFastLane: a theft victim's report starts the wanted clock from the battle's end, at any seat — #273's recovery runs on the law knowing quickly

witnessSet.law: possibly empty — an empty set writes the deed to #269's ledger with witnessedBy: [] and nothing here stirs
witnessSet.members: NPCs present (#93/#145), the victim (always, for their own loss), bystanders, participants
witnessSet.notWitnesses: Mochi — cries are not testimony (#136); a victim Mochi's behaviour is #273's territory
